sources.title: K2 Horizon 7B: Benchmarks, Pricing & Context Window — Benchgen
sources.snippet: K2-Horizon-7B is the medium-sized dense model in IFM's K2-Horizon family — a 7B-core decoder-only architecture evaluated across agentic, coding, long-context, and reasoning benchmarks. It ships with intermediate checkpoints released alongside the final model, plus public training data, recipe, training code, and evaluation resources — a notably high transparency bar for a model this size ...
